skill.name: minimalist-ui
skill.description: Creates clean editorial-style interfaces with warm monochrome colors, typographic contrast, flat bento grids, and muted pastel accents.
skill.summary: Guides AI tools to produce restrained minimalist frontend designs.
skill.author: leonxlnx

content.value_statement: Generic UI prompts often produce loud layouts and inconsistent visual systems. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code clear rules for restrained editorial interfaces.
actual_capabilities: Defines a warm monochrome palette with muted pastel accent colors.
Sets typography guidance for sans, serif, and monospace roles.
Bans common generic UI choices such as gradients, heavy shadows, and default fonts.
Specifies cards, buttons, tags, accordions, and keyboard shortcut styling.
Guides imagery, icon choices, spacing, and subtle motion for frontend layouts.
limitations: It gives design direction, not working components or installed packages.
Some font and icon suggestions may require separate licensing or setup.
The placeholder image URL may not suit private or offline projects.
It does not validate accessibility, performance, or brand compliance automatically.

use_cases.title: Shape a Product Dashboard
use_cases.description: Create a quiet dashboard with strong hierarchy, flat cards, and disciplined spacing.

use_cases.title: Refine Marketing Screens
use_cases.description: Turn a generic landing page into a restrained editorial layout with better typography.

use_cases.title: Standardize Interface Taste
use_cases.description: Give AI agents a shared visual direction for pages, components, and prototypes.

prompt_templates.title: Apply the Style
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a new screen.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a minimalist editorial homepage for a project management tool. Use warm monochrome colors, strong typography, flat cards, and muted accents.

prompt_templates.title: Refine an Existing Screen
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for improving a draft.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this interface and restyle it with the minimalist-ui rules. Keep the layout purpose, but remove gradients, heavy shadows, and generic styling.

prompt_templates.title: Create Component Direction
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for a design system pass.
prompt_templates.prompt: Define buttons, cards, tags, accordions, typography, spacing, and motion for a calm editorial product interface.

prompt_templates.title: Rebuild a Full Flow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for multi-screen product work.
prompt_templates.prompt: Redesign the onboarding, dashboard, and settings screens as one coherent minimalist UI system. Explain the visual hierarchy and interaction choices.

output_examples.input: Create a pricing page for a privacy-focused notes app.
output: A warm off-white canvas with one serif headline and concise supporting copy.
Three flat pricing cards with thin borders, quiet pastel tags, and charcoal primary actions.
Subtle scroll entry motion that uses opacity and transform only.
A restrained bento grid with clear information grouping and generous internal padding.
Muted status colors for alerts, labels, and trend markers.
No gradients, heavy shadows, or oversized rounded containers.

output_examples.input: Plan visual rules for a documentation site.
output: A type system with readable body text, editorial headings, and monospace metadata.
Flat accordions separated by fine dividers instead of boxed panels.
Desaturated imagery and minimal line illustrations for section depth.

best_practices: Provide product context, screen type, and target users before asking for visual output.
Ask for accessibility checks after the visual direction is applied.
Review external asset choices before shipping generated interfaces.
anti_patterns: Using the skill as a substitute for brand guidelines or usability testing.
Combining it with prompts that request bright gradients, heavy shadows, or generic icon libraries.
Expecting it to install fonts, icons, or image assets automatically.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps AI tools create minimalist frontend designs with editorial typography and flat component styling.

faq.question: Does it generate production-ready code?
faq.answer: It can guide code generation, but it is mainly a design direction skill.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it require specific fonts?
faq.answer: It recommends premium font styles. You may need to substitute licensed or locally available fonts.

faq.question: Is the placeholder image URL required?
faq.answer: No. It is only a suggestion for prototypes when real assets are not available.

faq.question: What should I check after using it?
faq.answer: Check accessibility, responsive behavior, brand fit, asset licensing, and performance.
